artifact_create.what: Record a produced thing by uri, optionally linked to a ticket
artifact_create.when: when you ship something the owner should see

artifact_read.when: when a ticket or link names it

artifact_upload.returns: the staged artifact; message_send(artifacts=[id]) finalizes it
artifact_upload.what: Stage a workspace file (25 MB cap) as an artifact

assemble_ruleset.returns: enforced lines + a doc index (full adds constructive), or a cycle/missing-layer error
assemble_ruleset.what: Compose a ticket's layered ruleset from its strategy/domain docs: enforced lines inlined, each doc one index line
assemble_ruleset.when: at the start of a story/task, for your working brief

board.what: An epic's ticket tree with status counts, ready/in_review lists and open gates
board.when: for the whole epic at a glance

close.returns: the checklist, or a transition error
close.what: Confirm an epic is closed and get the disarm checklist
close.when: as the owner, once an epic is done/partial

close_self.returns: the release result; then stop calling tools
close_self.what: End your own shell now; refused while inbox is non-empty or no status is recorded

context.returns: ContextSnapshot with a cursor for context_delta; `omitted` names each fetch
context.what: Load your ticket(s): chain, criteria, docs, thread, open asks; byte-capped unless verbose
context.when: at boot, after compaction without a cursor, or when a delta says resync_required

context_delta.returns: changes, next_cursor, has_more (byte-capped, `omitted` names the fetch); resync_required means context()
context_delta.what: Read what changed for you since a context cursor
context_delta.when: on a heartbeat wake, with your last cursor; not with context() routinely

criterion_create.returns: the criterion with its derived checker
criterion_create.what: Add a checkable done-fact. Checker derived: qa (story/epic), engineer (task), owner (knowledge ticket); checked_by needs owner override_reason. Max 6 fresh per story
criterion_create.when: before work starts, one per checkable fact

criterion_update.returns: the criterion and the pending count
criterion_update.what: Set a criterion's evidence_ref, then its verdict (checker only)
criterion_update.when: as the checker after the evidence doc exists; a doer attaches evidence_ref only

dense_search.what: Diagnostic: dense-only cosine top-k over an epic's live records
dense_search.when: when diagnosing why lookup missed a record

describe.returns: the schema and contract, or the enum values
describe.what: An object type's fields and contract, or an enum's values ('enums' = all, 'enum:<Name>' = one)
describe.when: unsure of a type's fields or an argument's allowed values

describe_objects.what: List object/enum names, or one object's schema
describe_objects.when: unsure of an object's contract; omit type to list names

doc_create.returns: the doc; link it to its ticket
doc_create.when: to record a design, strategy, domain guide, report or note

doc_edit.returns: a compact receipt, or a conflict/match error (re-read)
doc_edit.what: Apply exact, unique, non-overlapping edits to one doc version atomically
doc_edit.when: for small revisions after doc_read; match old_text against the original

doc_query.when: to find docs without an id

doc_read.returns: the doc; offset/limit/section: a version-pinned range
doc_read.what: Read a doc (latest or a version), whole or a bounded range
doc_read.when: when a ticket or link points at a doc

doc_update.what: Replace a doc's body/title as a new version
doc_update.when: to amend a doc you own

doctor_dead_mail.what: Broker publishes that had no recipient (publish_no_route)

doctor_feed_lag.what: Per live seat: unread addressed messages, their age, last request and output
doctor_feed_lag.when: a seat that does not answer or wake

doctor_health.returns: services + causes (named root causes with a fix and a guide)
doctor_health.what: Service health, the supervisor, package versions and pool reachability
doctor_health.when: first, for any 'it is broken' report

doctor_logs.returns: the tail, or the available logs
doctor_logs.what: A redacted log tail (secrets, user paths, emails and tokens scrubbed)
doctor_logs.when: after a health or pool cause names a service

doctor_pains.what: Open pain records (tools or guides found wrong)
doctor_pains.when: to see whether a symptom is already known

doctor_pool.what: Pool liveness, sessions, caps and usage, saturated caps and queued spawns
doctor_pool.when: seats not spawning, false deaths, slow spawns

events_query.what: Read the event log by subject or since a seq
events_query.when: to reconstruct or catch up on events

find.what: Search tickets, criteria, docs and messages by words or meaning; hits carry ticket_id and epic_id
find.when: to find something without its id

gate_answer.what: Answer an open human gate (owner only)
gate_answer.when: to resolve a gate a seat opened

gate_open.returns: the gate_opened event; the owner is notified
gate_open.what: Open a human gate on a ticket (one per gate at a time)
gate_open.when: when work needs a human decision

gates.when: to see if a ticket waits on a human

get_guide.what: Fetch one reference guide by name
get_guide.when: when a card or task names a guide

inbox.what: Questions and steers awaiting you, oldest first, each with answer_with
inbox.when: first when woken, and step 1 of closing

link_create.when: to attach a design, strategy, evidence, blocker, artifact or doc layer

link_delete.when: to undo a link made in error

link_query.when: to see what something is linked to

lookup.what: Current decisions, claims and lessons for a question, id or path in one epic (binding ones always)
lookup.when: on resume or before acting, instead of trusting memory

message_query.returns: the messages and a last_seq hint
message_query.what: List thread messages oldest first with seq; since_seq returns only newer ones
message_query.when: to read or poll a thread

message_read.what: Read one message with its seq, parent and replies
message_read.when: when a feed event or reply_to names it

message_send.returns: the message; asks reach the recipient's feed
message_send.what: Post to a ticket thread: a participant/role/@handle, or a note

participants.what: List humans and seats, optionally by role, with @handle and reach
participants.when: to find a collaborator, then message_send(to='@'+handle)

preflight.returns: the numbers and rules of thumb
preflight.what: Host free RAM and live seats vs pool caps; advisory, never blocks

propose_fix.what: Propose ONE fix as an admin approval card showing the exact action; nothing runs until an admin approves, then the result is posted on your thread
propose_fix.when: after the evidence names a root cause a listed action fixes

reap.what: Tear down a seat's shell (dead, or the resident architect at epic close)
reap.when: to clear a dead seat or close the architect after the epic

record_claim.what: Record something stated but not yet shown, with basis and evidence
record_claim.when: when you assert something without attached proof

record_decision.what: Record what is in force, why, and which decisions it replaces
record_decision.when: the moment a ruling or in-authority decision is made, before acting on it

record_lesson.what: Record a lesson: domain, topic, one sentence, evidence ids

record_status.returns: the message and who was told
record_status.what: Record your outcome with a one-line note to your spawner, architect and owner
record_status.when: at milestones and as step 2 of closing

resume.what: Resume a parked or stalled session

resume_self.returns: identity, ordered steps, monitor_cmd + cron, open asks; see get_guide('resume')
resume_self.what: Resume after a park, reap, crash or respawn: re-arm wakes, list open asks and steps
resume_self.when: first call of a resumed shell, after compaction, or when unsure Monitor/cron are alive

session_query.when: to check a seat is live

set_binding.what: Promote or demote a live decision's binding flag (architect/owner); audited
set_binding.when: when re-judging which decisions every seat must follow

spawn.returns: the session, or status running (poll session_query)
spawn.what: Start a seat for a role on a ticket
spawn.when: to delegate a story/task or spawn a checker

subscribe.returns: the monitor command and heartbeat cron to arm
subscribe.what: Arm your event feed (once per session)

ticket_create.returns: the ticket, or a scope error at a cap
ticket_create.what: Create an epic (owner), story (architect; owner: a quick task, tag quick, no parent) or task. At most 8 open stories per epic (raised via a scope gate), at most 5 tasks per story
ticket_create.when: when you own a new slice of work

ticket_query.what: List tickets matching the filter args
ticket_query.when: to find tickets without an id

ticket_read.what: One read of a ticket: record, chain, criteria, docs, children, blockers, gates, newest thread (thread_seq), links
ticket_read.when: when you need a ticket's full state

ticket_update.returns: the ticket, or an error naming what is missing
ticket_update.what: Change the args given, per the transition rules
ticket_update.when: to move or assign a ticket; in_review only once verified

topic_propose.returns: the proposed doc with Source + fetched-at in its header
topic_propose.what: File a proposed Library doc from a page topic_research fetched; the owner approves it
topic_propose.when: after research, or to propose the next version of a topic doc

topic_research.returns: search results or the page text, plus the fetch receipt
topic_research.what: Search skills.sh or read one page for your Library topic (skills.sh, GitHub, the seed host only)
topic_research.when: a topic seat's research step, before proposing a doc

whoami.returns: the participant, tickets, bundles and server version
whoami.what: Your identity, role, open tickets, lineage and tool bundles

why_stuck.what: Why a ticket does not move: gates nobody can answer, a missing checker or doer seat, blockers, the next edges' missing preconditions, a full cap
why_stuck.when: a stuck ticket, epic or gate

withdraw_claim.what: Withdraw a claim with no successor; lookup never returns it again
withdraw_claim.when: when a claim was superseded or wrong and nothing replaces it

withdraw_decision.what: Withdraw a decision with no successor; lookup never returns it again
withdraw_decision.when: when a decision was wrong and nothing replaces it

workflow_check.what: Validate a workflow version and walk its status graph (unreachable, dead ends)
workflow_check.when: a stuck walk under a custom workflow, or a failed update compat check
